findings.title: Cache is not re-checked after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: GetWebAssets reads entryPointAssetsCache under RLock, then acquires the exclusive lock without re-checking the cache. In non-dev mode, goroutines that observed a nil cache before another goroutine populated it will all proceed to reload the manifest after acquiring the lock. If one of those delayed reloads fails, it assigns nil to entryPointAssetsCache and can replace a previously valid cached value, causing subsequent requests to fail or reload repeatedly. Re-check `cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil` immediately after Lock and return the existing cache.

findings.title: Exclusive mutex is held during file/CDN I/O
findings.body: The deferred entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Unlock() means the global exclusive lock is held while reading assets-manifest.json from disk and, if the CDN path is enabled, while making an HTTP request. This serializes all GetWebAssets callers during potentially slow I/O; a slow CDN or filesystem stall can block all web-asset responses. Load the assets outside the critical section, or use singleflight/once, and only update the cache under the lock.

findings.title: Typo in error message
findings.body: The error message says 'asssets-manifest' with three s's; it should be 'assets-manifest'.
